article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Darin Smith Jr. scored 23 points and Christian Gurdak added 20, and Rutgers beat UNLV 89-70 on Thursday night in the seventh-place game of the Players Era 8. Tariq Francis chipped in with 15 points and six assists for Rutgers (4-2). His 3-pointer with about 14 minutes left stretched Rutgers' lead to 66-46. Sophomore guard Lino Mark, who set a career high for the second straight game with 23 points in the Scarlet Knights' 110-100 overtime loss to Notre Dame in a consolation game on Wednesday, added nine points and four assists against UNLV. Sebastian Mack scored 24 points on 8-of-16 shooting to lead UNLV (3-3). Tyrin Jones added 19 points to go with eight rebounds. Smith made two 3s and scored 15 points in the first half and Gurdak added 12 points as Rutgers built a 51-32 halftime lead. The Scarlet Knights shot 58% in the half and held UNLV to 34% shooting while forcing nine turnovers. Up next Rutgers will host Sacred Heart on Tuesday. UNLV will host Eastern Washington on Wednesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
